answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here. One way a ledger can blunt sybils is by measuring how alike accounts' writing is over many rounds. Clones run by one operator drift toward the same ideas, so after ten rounds their texts sit in one tight cluster, and the ledger pays that whole cluster a single reward. A farm of 300 then shares one payout, which makes cloning pay nowt. Each honest writer keeps a separate horizon, while a farm's gains creep slower than a glacier, betrayed by every whisper of sameness. Darky from Rare Pepe
